en: Black-and-white photograph showing a large, formally posed group of mostly women and a few men gathered indoors around a long table. The central table has several tall candles and what appear to be top hats in front of the seated men, who are wearing dark suits and mustaches—possibly part of a humorous or ceremonial event. The women, dressed in 1930s–1940s style dresses and blouses, stand and sit in multiple rows behind and beside the table, smiling toward the camera. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the front.
